Retry evaluation attempts persist started/complete/failed state and wall time; killed attempt remains unknown. Old readable evaluation metrics are separated from unknown incomplete costs.

Complete status requires existence of scheduled 0/10/20 JSON+JSONL pairs; paused current explicitly pending boundary may be deferred, earlier ones cannot. --include-validation controls full raw replay, existence checks apply independently.

Resolved in final_cp0 candidate: fresh branch atomically saves CP0 before initial evaluation, records write seconds/bytes, then checks STOP/deadline. CP0 resume enters pending branch and does not recommit CP0. A partial failed initial evaluation is archived before replay; optimizer state is correctly empty at CP0.

Standalone decoded text containing U+FFFD cannot pass the equality fast path; actual vLLM incremental replay is mandatory. The real UTF-8 tail fixture rejects forged standalone text, while its saved runtime text passes.

saved_validation_auditor lazily loads and verifies original tokenizer/model config assets once; every earlier saved evaluation passes tokenizer explicitly to audit_evaluation. Asset failure or consistent same-length ID/trace change with mismatching saved text rejects before archive/run evidence writes.

limitations: Static independent review, not a GPU recovery demonstration. STOP/deadline prevents launching new evaluation; it does not abort an evaluation already in progress.
